chunks: And whatever was in it from Rūḥ ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥīm, I have narrated it from Jaʿfar ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah al-Kūfī, from his grandfather al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Kūfī, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from Ghālib ibn ʿUthmān, from Rūḥ ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥīm.

key_terms.الْكُوفِيِّ: A nisbah meaning from Kūfah, identifying the narrator’s regional attribution.
key_terms.جَدِّهِ: His grandfather; indicating a familial link within the chain.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement of direct narration by the compiler.
key_terms.رُوحِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ: A narrator from whom these reports are transmitted.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Rūḥ ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥīm in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage provides the sanad/isnad through which the compiler transmits narrations from Rūḥ ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥīm. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission and preserving the scholarly chain for hadith attribution in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
